Two of those Grand Tour stage wins, including a Tour de France stage win in 2022, came after a life-threatening crash at the Tour of Poland in 2020. Recent years have been less successful for Jakobsen, who has battled various health issues, including iliac artery problems. "We had been looking for a specialist for the pure flat sprints. The more we looked into Fabio's situation, the more convinced we became that there is still a great deal of untapped potential," said Visma head of performance Mathieu Heijboer. "We believe we can create the right environment to help him unlock it. At the same time, having Fabio join us now allows us to start working with Fabio straight away instead of waiting until next season."
